rules.name: AION 2 meter card (Wayland)
rules.notes: A2M-50: the card as a native Wayland toplevel. 'above_fullscreen enable' (patched sway, draws it over fullscreen gamescope) is emitted from swayfx-config.nix under systemSettings.swayAboveFullscreen, not here: sway-apps rejects unknown command words and an unpatched sway would too.

shortcuts.name: AION 2 meter overlay: show/hide
shortcuts.notes: the meter card (AionMeter.Overlay, Wayland app_id aionmeter, above fullscreen gamescope through above_fullscreen): SIGUSR2 hide/show if running, else start it. Helper from system/app/aion2-meter-daemon.nix

shortcuts.name: AION 2 meter: click-through
shortcuts.notes: SIGUSR1 (click-through toggle) to the pid in $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/aionmeter-overlay.pid. Never pkill -f: USR1 also hits the launcher shells. Takes over nix's duplicate fullscreen toggle (Hyper+f stays).

shortcuts.name: AION 2 meter card: show and raise
shortcuts.notes: A2M-50: the Avalonia tools window is retired (2026-10-14); the card hosts every tab. A second aionmeter-overlay hands 'show' to the running card over $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/aionmeter-overlay.sock (unhides and presents it) and exits; with no card it starts one. Not Hyper+Alt+g: Hyper already includes Alt (Mod4+Control+Mod1).
